text:
Jon: Heads-up: PR #5112 introduces a tiny Console observability mini-guide (latency-shading + cost-attribution-by-tag) and updates tracing-hook examples to prefer `trace_context` (old key was `trace_ctx`). Need a docs owner to run linkcheck, confirm snippets, and add a short note about runtime compatibility. cc @DevEx Priya @SRE Minh
DevEx Priya: I can take this. Paste the staging preview?
Jon: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/5112/preview — changes: new short guide under Console > Observability called 'Latency shading & cost tags', dashboard preset files, and Node/Python/Go snippet updates for the trace key rename. Also a small example for cost attribution using route tags.
Rae (product): Can we include a one-line before/after example for latency shading so PMs have something to show in release notes? Something compact: "median 118ms -> 96ms; p99 305ms -> 262ms; est cost/unit $0.0050 -> $0.0043" (illustrative).
SRE Minh: I'll run a microbench and drop numbers in the PR thread. Note: runtime v2.4 adds a compatibility shim that accepts `trace_ctx` and maps to `trace_context`, but older runtimes (<2.4) will require manual edits. Please call that out.
Alba (eng-runtime): Confirming Minh's note. We'll add a short compatibility blurb in the guide and mention the SDK mapping behaviour.
DevEx Priya: Running docs smoke + linkcheck: `./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 5112 --suite quick --linkcheck`
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 5112 -> staging (ETA ~2m)
DevEx Priya: Smoke: PASS. Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor (old-tracehook#examples). Leaving comment on the PR with suggested redirect.
Jon: I'll patch the anchor and add a redirect to the new mini-guide. Also adding a compact migration snippet showing how to translate the context key in each SDK.
DevEx Priya: Snippet suggestions welcomed. For Node show single-line mapping; Python keep dict style; Go show context.Value usage.
Jon: Drafted snippets in the PR comment: 
```js
// JS migration
// old
span.setTag('trace_ctx', ctx.trace_ctx)
// new
span.setTag('trace_context', ctx.trace_context)
```
```py
# Python migration
# old
span.tags['trace_ctx'] = ctx['trace_ctx']
# new
span.tags['trace_context'] = ctx['trace_context']
```
```go
// Go migration
// old
span.SetTag("trace_ctx", ctx.Value("trace_ctx"))
// new
span.SetTag("trace_context", ctx.Value("trace_context"))
```
DevEx Priya: Pushed snippet formatting fix (commit e7a1f2). Re-ran linkcheck after the anchor patch.
SRE Minh: Microbench summary (short): median down ~19%, p99 down ~14%, token cost per request down ~11%. Dropping the concise numbers into the guide as Rae suggested. Note: results vary; added a clear caveat and a link to the eval notebook.
Rae (product): Thanks. Can you also add a one-line checklist at the top: 1) Upgrade runtime to v2.4+ or SDKs to v4.0+ for automatic mapping; 2) If pinned, replace `trace_ctx` -> `trace_context`; 3) Update dashboards/alerts to use new keys.
Alba (eng-runtime): I'll add a phrase about telemetry backfills: using old keys in historical dashboards is fine, but new ingest will prefer `trace_context`.
DevEx Priya: Linkcheck now clean. Pushed a tiny docs copy tweak to clarify the shading widget settings (commit f2c9b4).
deploy-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 5112 -> staging (status: success)
DevEx Priya: Approved the PR after CI green.
Jon: Merged to main and backported the mini-guide to the 4.x docs set. Closing thread  thanks everyone for quick turn-around! :tada:
